100.title: I have decided
100.lyrics:
1. I have decided to follow Jesus
I have decided to follow Jesus
I have decided to follow Jesus

No turning back. No turning back.

2. Though all may leave me Still I will follow (3)
No turning back. No turning back.

3. The Cross before me The world behind me (3)
No turning back. No turning back.

4. Will you decide now, to follow jesus (3)
No turning back. No turning back.
